takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: سنن النسائی/الجھاد ۴۸ (۳۱۹۵)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۹۳۵۷)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: عبداللہ بن عباس رضی اللہ عنہما کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم said: He who leaves the snakes along through fear of their pursuit, does not belong to us. We have not made peace with them since we have fought with them.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبوداود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۶۲۲۱)، وقد أخرجہ: مسند احمد (۱/۲۳۰)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: عباس بن عبدالمطلب رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Al-Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib: Al-Abbas said to the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم: We wish to sweep out Zamzam, but in it there are some of these Jinnan, meaning small snakes; so the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم ordered that they should be killed.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۵۱۳۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: عبداللہ بن عمر رضی اللہ عنہما سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Ibn Umar reported the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم as saying: Kill snakes, kill those which have two streaks and those with small tails, for they obliterate the eyesight and cause miscarriage. Salim said: Abdullah (bin Umar) used to kill every snake which he found. Abu Lubabah or Zaid bin al-Khattab saw him chasing a snake. He said: He (the Prophet) prohibited house-snakes.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح البخاری/بدء الخلق ۱۴ (۳۲۹۷)، صحیح مسلم/السلام ۳۷ (۲۲۳۳)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۱۴۷)، وقد أخرجہ: سنن ابن ماجہ/الطب ۴۲ (۳۵۳۵)، موطا امام مالک/الاستئذان ۱۲ (۳۲)، مسند احمد (۳/۴۳۰، ۴۵۲، ۴۵۳)
wazahat: وضاحت: ۱؎ : اس لئے کہ وہ جن و شیاطین بھی ہو سکتے ہیں، انہیں مارنے سے پہلے وہاں سے غائب ہو جانے یا اپنی شکل تبدیل کر لینے کی تین بار آگاہی دے دینی چاہئے اگر وہ وہاں سے غائب نہ ہو پائیں یا اپنی شکل نہ بدلیں تو دوسری روایات کی روشنی میں مار سکتا ہے۔

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: ابولبابہ رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Abu Lubabah said: The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم prohibited killing the jinnan (small snakes) that are in the house, except the one which have two streaks and the one with small tail, for they obliterate the eyesight and cause miscarriage.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر ما قبلہ، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۱۴۷)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: نافع سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Nafi said: After that, that is, after Abu Lubabah had mentioned him this tradition, Ibn Umar found a snake in his house; he commanded regarding it and it was driven away to al-Baqi'.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۱۴۷)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: اسامہ نے نافع سے یہی حدیث روایت کی ہے
translation: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Nafi through a different chain of transmitters. In this version Nafi said: After that I saw it again in his house.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۱۴۷)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: محمد بن ابو یحییٰ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Abu Saeed al-Khudri: Muhammad ibn Abu Yahya said that his father told that he and his companion went to Abu Saeed al-Khudri to pay a sick visit to him. He said: Then we came out from him and met a companion of ours who wanted to go to him. We went ahead and sat in the mosque. He then came back and told us that he heard Abu Saeed al-Khudri say: The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم said: Some snakes are jinn; so when anyone sees one of them in his house, he should give it a warning three times. If it return (after that), he should kill it, for it is a devil.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۴۴۴۴)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: ابوسائب کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Abu al-Saib said I went to visit Abu Sa’ld al-Khudri, and while I was sitting I heard a movement under under his couch. When I looked and found a snake there, I got up. Abu Sa’ld said: what is with you? I said: Here is a snake. He said: what do you want ? I said: I shall kill it. He then pointed to a room in his house in front of his room and said: My cousin (son of my uncle) was in this room. He asked his permission to go to his wife on the occasion of the battle of Troops (Ahzab), as he was recently married. The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم gave him permission and ordered him to take his weapon with him. He came to his house and found his wife standing at the door of the house. When he pointed to her with the lance, she said; do not make haste till you see what has brought me out. He entered the house and found an ugly snake there. He pierced in the lance while it was quivering. He said: I do not know which of them died first, the man or the snake. His people then came to the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم and said: supplicate Allah to restore our companion to life for us. He said: Ask forgiveness for your Companion. Then he said: In Madina a group of Jinn have embraced Islam, so when you see one of them, pronounce a waring to it three times and if it appears to you after that, kill it after three days.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح مسلم/السلام ۳۷ (۲۲۳۶)، سنن الترمذی/الصید ۱۵ (۱۴۸۴)، موطا امام مالک/الاستئذان ۱۲ (۳۳)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۴۴۱۳)، وقد أخرجہ: مسند احمد (۳/۴۱)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: اس سند سے ابن عجلان سے یہی حدیث مختصراً مروی ہے، اس میں ہے کہ
translation: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Ibn 'Ajilan through a different chain of narrators briefly. This version has: He should give it a warning three times. If it appears to him after that, he should kill it, for it is a devil.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر حدیث رقم : (۵۲۵۷)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۴۴۱۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: ہشام بن زہرہ کے غلام ابوسائب نے خبر دی ہے کہ
translation: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Abu Saeed al-Khudri in a similar manner through a different chain of narrators. This version is more perfect. In this version he said: give it a warning for three days; if it appears to you after that, then kill it, for it is only a devil.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر حدیث رقم : (۵۲۵۷)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۴۴۱۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: ابولیلیٰ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Abdur Rahman Ibn Abu Layla: The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم was asked about the house-snakes. He said: When you see one of them in your dwelling, say: I adjure you by the covenant which Noah made with you, and I adjure you by the covenant which Solomon made with you not to harm us. Then if they come back, kill them.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: سنن الترمذی/الصید ۱۵ (۱۴۸۵)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۱۵۲)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing snakes.
narrator: ابن مسعود رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Masud: Kill all the snakes except the little white one which looks like a silver wand. Abu Dawud said: A man said to me: A white snake does not wind in its movement. If it is correct, that is a sign in it, if Allah wills.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۹۱۵۹)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing geckos.
narrator: سعد رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Amir bin Saad, quoting his father, said: The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم ordered a gecko to be killed, and calling it a noxious little creature.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح مسلم/السلام ۳۸ (۲۲۳۷)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۳۸۹۳)، وقد أخرجہ: مسند احمد (۱/۱۷۷، ۱۷۹)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing geckos.
narrator: ابوہریرہ رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم said: If anyone kills a gecko with the first blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him, if he kills it with the second blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him less than the former; and if he kills it with the third blow, such and such number of good deeds will be recorded for him, less than the former.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح مسلم/السلام ۳۸ (۲۲۴۰)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۷۳۱، ۱۲۵۸۸، ۱۵۴۸۷)، وقد أخرجہ: سنن الترمذی/الأحکام ۱ (۱۴۸۲)، سنن ابن ماجہ/الصید ۱۲ (۳۲۲۸)، مسند احمد (۲/۳۵۵)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing geckos.
narrator: ابوہریرہ رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم said: For the first blow seventy good deeds will be recorded.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر ما قبلہ، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۲۵۸۸)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing ants.
narrator: ابوہریرہ رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Abu Hurairah reported the prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم as saying: A prophet got down beneath a tree and he was stung by an ant. He ordered regarding the baggage and it was removed from beneath it. He then ordered regarding it and it was burnt. Allah then revealed to him: why not (just) one ant?
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح مسلم/السلام ۳۹ (۲۲۴۱)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۳۳۱۹، ۱۵۳۰۷، ۱۳۸۷۵)، وقد أخرجہ: صحیح البخاری/الجھاد ۱۵۳(۳۰۱۹)، بدء الخلق ۱۶ (۳۳۱۹)، سنن النسائی/الصید ۳۸ (۴۳۶۳)، سنن ابن ماجہ/الصید ۱۰ (۳۲۲۵)، مسند احمد (۲/۴۰۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing ants.
narrator: ابوہریرہ رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Abu Hurairah reported Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم as saying: An ant stung a prophet. He ordered a colony of ants to be burned. Allah revealed to him: because an ant stung you, you have perished a community which glorifies Me.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح البخاری/ الجہاد ۱۵۳ (۳۰۱۹)، بدء الخلق ۱۶ (۳۳۱۹)، صحیح مسلم/ السلام ۳۹ (۲۲۴۱)، سنن النسائی/ الصید ۳۸ (۴۳۶۳)، سنن ابن ماجہ/ الصید ۱۰ (۳۲۲۵)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۳۳۱۹، ۱۵۳۰۷)، وقد أخرجہ: مسند احمد (۲/۴۰۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing ants.
narrator: عبداللہ بن عباس رضی اللہ عنہما کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم prohibited to kill four creatures: ants, bees, hoopoes, and sparrow-hawks.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: سنن ابن ماجہ/الصید ۱۰ (۳۲۲۴)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۵۸۵۰)، وقد أخرجہ: مسند احمد (۱/۳۳۲)، سنن الدارمی/الأضاحي ۲۶ (۲۱۴۲)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing ants.
narrator: عبداللہ (عبداللہ بن مسعود) رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Abdur-Rahman bin Abdullah quoted his father as saying: When we were on a journey with the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم and he had gone to releive himself, we saw a Hummarah with two young ones. We took the young ones. The Hummarah came and began to spread out its wings. Then the prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم came and said: who has pained this young by the loss of her young? Give her young ones back to her. We also saw an ant-hill which we had burned. He asked? Who has burned this? We replied: we have. He said: it is not fitting that anyone but the lord of the fire should punish with fire.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر حدیث رقم : (۲۶۷۵)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۹۳۶۲)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding killing frogs.
narrator: عبدالرحمٰن بن عثمان سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Abdur Rahman ibn Uthman: When a physician consulted the Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم about putting frogs in medicine, he forbade him to kill them.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: انظر حدیث رقم : (۳۸۷۱)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۹۷۰۶)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding throwing stones.
narrator: عبداللہ بن مغفل رضی اللہ عنہ کہتے ہیں کہ
translation: Abd bin Mughaffal said: The Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم prohibited throwing pebbles (in sport) saying: game is not caught by such means. Neither is an enemy injured, but it may sometimes put out an eye or break a tooth.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح البخاری/تفسیر سورة الفتح ۵ (۴۸۴۱)، الذبائح ۵ (۵۴۷۹)، الأدب ۱۲۲ (۶۲۲۰)، صحیح مسلم/الذبائح ۱۰ (۱۹۵۴)، سنن ابن ماجہ/الصید ۱۱ (۳۲۲۷)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۹۶۶۳)، وقد أخرجہ: سنن النسائی/القسامة ۳۳ (۴۸۱۹)، مسند احمد (۴/۸۶، ۵/۴۶، ۵۴، ۵۵، ۵۶، ۵۷)

baab: CHAPTER: Regarding circumcision.
narrator: ام عطیہ انصاریہ رضی اللہ عنہا سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Umm Atiyyah al-Ansariyyah: A woman used to perform circumcision in Madina. The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم said to her: Do not cut severely as that is better for a woman and more desirable for a husband. Abu Dawud said: It has been transmitted by Ubaid Allah bin Amr from Abd al-Malik to the same effect through a different chain. Abu Dawud said: It is not a strong tradition. It has been transmitted in mursal form (missing the link of the Companions) Abu Dawud said: Muhammad bin Hasan is obscure, and this tradition is weak.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۸۰۹۳)

baab: CHAPTER: Women walking with men in the street.
narrator: ابواسید انصاری رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Abu Usayd al-Ansari: Abu Usayd heard the Messenger of Allah صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم say when he was coming out of the mosque, and men and women were mingled in the road: Draw back, for you must not walk in the middle of the road; keep to the sides of the road. Then women were keeping so close to the wall that their garments were rubbing against it.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۱۱۹۲)

baab: CHAPTER: Women walking with men in the street.
narrator: عبداللہ بن عمر رضی اللہ عنہما سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم prohibited that one, i. e. man, should walk between two women.
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: تفرد بہ أبو داود، (تحفة الأشراف: ۷۶۶۲)

baab: CHAPTER: Verbally abusing time.
narrator: ابوہریرہ رضی اللہ عنہ سے روایت ہے کہ
translation: Abu Hurairah reported the prophet صلی ‌اللہ ‌علیہ ‌وسلم as saying: Allah most high says: “The son of Adam injures me by abusing time, whereas I am time. Authority is in my hand. I alternate the night and the day”. Ibn al-Sarh said: “on the authority of Ibn al-Musayyab instead of Saeed .
takhreej: تخریج دارالدعوہ: صحیح البخاری/تفسیر سورة الجاثیة ۱ (۴۸۲۶)، التوحید ۳۵ (۷۴۹۱)، الأدب ۱۰۱ (۶۱۸۱)، صحیح مسلم/الألفاظ من الأدب ۱ (۲۲۴۶)، (تحفة الأشراف: ۱۳۱۳۱)، وقد أخرجہ: موطا امام مالک/الکلام ۱ (۳)
